consequence.statement: The metric is no longer exposed under the name envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_rate_limit_enforced and is instead exposed as envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_rate_limit_enforced, so metric consumers still querying the old name no longer receive it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and queries that reference the old metric name to use envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_rate_limit_enforced.

decision.reason: [ev-caf88a546536] lists this metric under 1.17 "Changed Metrics" as renamed from the old name to the new one. [ev-77f05428497a] confirms that the prefix of all Envoy NPDS metrics was renamed from envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_ to envoy_cilium_npds_. So the metric is no longer published under the old name, and anything still querying that name stops getting it. The evidence doesn't say that any component fails, is rejected or has to be migrated, so behavior-change (review class, low severity) with a remediation to update dashboards and alerts is the supported kind and doesn't overstate the work required.
